Holomoku Vandal:

Design and Aesthetics: The Holomoku Vandal skin features a sleek, futuristic design inspired by cybernetic and neon elements. Its holographic textures and vibrant color palette make it visually striking on the battlefield.

Special Effects: This skin includes custom animations, sound effects, and finishers. When equipped, players experience a distinct visual and auditory feedback, enhancing the overall gameplay experience.

Customization: Players can further personalize the Holomoku Vandal with additional chromas and variants, allowing for a degree of individuality and expression in their weapon choice.

Holomoku Kaimana:

Design and Aesthetics: The Holomoku Kaimana skin is a masterpiece of aquatic-themed artistry, featuring deep blue hues and fluid, wave-like patterns. Its design pays homage to oceanic elements, giving it a serene yet powerful presence.

Special Effects: Similar to the Vandal, the Kaimana skin offers unique visual effects that mimic the flow and shimmer of water. The custom reload animations and sound effects add an immersive layer to the gameplay.

Customization: The skin offers a range of variants, each reflecting different aspects of marine life, from coral reefs to deep-sea mysteries. These options allow players to select the variant that best suits their style.
